fact: The PAGDS project page states that the SGCH hospital information system was designed by the Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène Publique et de la Couverture Maladie Universelle, that it manages the medical record and gives each patient a unique identifier under which the patient can be taken in charge at any health centre in the country that has the solution; the page is undated and gives no count of sites.
title: Les choses à savoir sur le système d'information hospitalier
publisher: Projet d'Amélioration de la Gouvernance pour la Délivrance des Services de base aux citoyens (PAGDS)
